_comment: Optional per-project corrections, keyed by stable project id or slug. entry_path is repository-relative. playable_status may only be set to a value in DECLARED_REVIEWED_STATUSES (scripts/collect_repositories.py) and must carry a note with the evidence.

t-minus.note: XDracam/spaceappschallenge2026: game/index.html is a bundler shell - it references "%BASE_URL%favicon.svg" / "%BASE_URL%fonts/fonts.css" and "root-relative:/src/main.tsx", so the game needs a build step rather than being served as a static page.

jester.note: aaron-sulbaran/jester: app/index.html <title> is "Jester" (the *-lab.html pages are debug tools).

earthfm-listening-game.note: Aarosunn/SpaceApps: EarthFM/ is a Next.js app (next.config.ts, app/, components/); README requires "npm install && npm run dev". UI/viewer/index.html is a prototype gallery, not an entrypoint.

cascade.note: Prokopiy8247/Fable5-2-Natural-Disasters: games/01-cascade is a Unity project (Assets/, Packages/, ProjectSettings/, Builds/, PLAY.bat). No HTML in the repository.

mesocyclone.note: Prokopiy8247/Fable5-2-Natural-Disasters: games/02-mesocyclone is a Unity project. No HTML in the repository.

zero.note: Prokopiy8247/Fable5-2-Natural-Disasters: games/03-zero is a Unity project. No HTML in the repository.

fableflight.note: Rolandjg/fableflight is a Rust binary (Cargo.toml, src/, assets/). Native build; no browser artifact.

tropical-island.note: Tarzno/tropical_island is a Godot 4 project (project.godot, export_presets.cfg, scenes/main.tscn). Needs a Godot export, not a browser.

out-of-reach.note: alex-slovakia/out-of-reach is a Unity project (Assets/Scenes/SampleScene.unity, ProjectSettings/, Packages/). HTML in the repo is documentation only.

superforge-gt.note: jreinach-alt/sf-gt is a C project (Makefile, engine/, allocator/). Native build; no browser artifact.
